verdict.rationale: Raygun documents APM rules whose triggered issues automatically create PagerDuty incidents and send Slack notifications. It also supports conditional 'ignore by rule' and time- or occurrence-based conditions that change error status automatically. This is real event-to-action automation, but it is limited to notifications and status handling, and the docs say little about how rules are defined. missing for 10: a general rule or workflow builder with custom actions, webhook or arbitrary action targets, detailed rule-definition docs, rules covering crash-reporting alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
